A thrilling game had seen Clive Allen put 토트넘 홋스퍼 ahead in the second minute with his 49th goal of the season, only for Dave Bennett to equalise in the ninth minute. Gary Mabbutt restored 토트넘 홋스퍼's lead after 40 minutes, but Keith Houchen 's 64th-minute equaliser for 코번트리 시티 forced extra time.
